learning_outcomes.text: Analyze and dynamically describe control systems.
Use relevant software tools to perform control engineering tasks.

syllabus_topics: Description of dynamic systems in the time domain
Description of dynamic systems in the frequency domain
Control loop elements and transfer behavior
Measurement of the system parameters of a DC motor
Simulation and measurement of the step response
Setup of speed control with Rapid Control Prototyping Hardware
Experimental design and setup of a position control
Experimental design of a temperature controller: Ziegler-Nichols in conjunction with the Aström-Hägglund method
Commissioning of the temperature control loop with pulse width modulation and anti-windup
